name: Cajamarca Antpitta
rangeDescription: Andes of northern peru (cajamarca)
description: Small antpitta with a restricted range in the western Andes of northwestern Peru. Note the chestnut brown plumage and pale belly; like other antpittas, it has long legs and a short tail.

name: Koepcke's Hermit
rangeDescription: Foothills of east slope of andes of peru
description: Large, orangish hermit from the Andean foothills. Light orange with a grayish-green back and a black mask typical of hermits.

name: Iberian Gray Shrike
rangeDescription: Iberian peninsula and southern france
description: Thrush-sized bird; pale gray overall with black mask. Found in open, dry desert and semidesert areas across Portugal and Spain, into France.

name: Louisiade Pitta
rangeDescription: Rossel (louisiade archipelago, off southeastern new guinea)
description: A very shy, and seldom seen ground bird of lowland and foothill rainforest. Bright red belly and blue chest separated by a black band.

name: Black-browed Barbet
rangeDescription: Montane forest of malay peninsula and sumatra
description: Loud but sluggish and difficult-to-see canopy inhabitant of highland forests in peninsular Malaysia and Sumatra. Note the leaf-green body, brightly colored face, and heavy black bill.

name: Orange-collared Manakin
rangeDescription: Pacific slope of southern costa rica and western panama (east to azuero peninsula)
description: Small, plump, and short tailed with unmistakable color pattern: bright orange “collar” (mostly neck and throat) with contrasting black cap and wings. Female much different than male: dull olive-green with slightly brighter yellow belly.

name: Pale-footed Swallow
rangeDescription: Andes of colombia and western venezuela to western bolivia
description: Uncommon swallow in montane forest in the Andes from Venezuela to Bolivia. Similar to the more common Blue-and-white Swallow, but look for the buffy throat and browner flanks on Pale-footed Swallow.

name: Blue-fronted Fig-Parrot
rangeDescription: Western new guinea (western bird's head peninsula), including salawati (raja ampat islands, off western new guinea)
description: A small, short-tailed parrot of lowland forest, forest edge, and lush gardens. Mostly found at low elevations, and sometimes up into the hills.

name: Gray-headed Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: Northern moluccas (morotai, halmahera, bacan, tidore, and ternate)
description: A small, strikingly handsome green dove with contrastingly pale gray head and markings on the back and wings, a deep claret-colored belly patch, and a lemon-yellow underside to the tail. Unique within its limited range in the north Moluccas.

name: Ethiopian Cisticola
rangeDescription: Ethiopia
description: A relatively colorful, mid-sized, long-tailed cisticola. Note the gray-brown back with thick black streaks, the rufous on the wing and cap, and the whitish underparts.

name: Shovel-billed Kookaburra
rangeDescription: New guinea (primarily in hills and adjacent lowlands)
description: A huge, rare kingfisher of rainforest interior from lowlands to mid-mountains. Its unnaturally large bill makes it look almost unrecognisable as a kingfisher.

name: White-rumped Sirystes
rangeDescription: Western venezuela and eastern colombia southward to southwestern brazil and northwestern bolivia
description: Distinctive black, gray, and white flycatcher of rainforest midstory and canopy. Medium-sized flycatcher with a small bushy crest; white underneath, gray above with a black head, wings, and tail.

name: Pale-headed Jacamar
rangeDescription: Tropical northeastern colombia and northwestern venezuela
description: Small jacamar with a pale brown head and bluish-black wings and tail. Smaller than other jacamars in range, with a shorter tail.

name: Brown Violetear
rangeDescription: Belize and guatemala to the guianas, brazil, and bolivia
description: Uncommon, rather large but drab, fairly short-billed hummingbird of tropical and subtropical forest and edge. Can be aggressive when defending flower patches from most other hummingbirds.

name: Scarlet-throated Tanager
rangeDescription: Arid interior of northeastern brazil
description: Large tanager that resembles an icterid. Males are glossy black with a bright red throat, which is absent on females.

name: Sao Tome Prinia
rangeDescription: São tomé island (gulf of guinea)
description: An active, slender, unstreaked warbler with a long graduated tail that is sometimes cocked. Gray above and pale below.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Boulder Chat
rangeDescription: Southeastern zambia to botswana, southern malawi, zimbabwe, and mozambique
description: Large, unique, sooty-colored chat with a proportionately small head and long broad white-tipped tail (except on central feathers), often seen only on spread tail. White spots in wings are obvious only in flight.

name: Sungrebe
rangeDescription: Tropical lowlands of southern mexico to northeastern argentina and brazil
description: Retiring, small swimming bird of tropical lowlands. It’s not a grebe and it doesn’t like the sun; instead it favors slow-moving shady streams, mangroves, quiet ponds, and lake edges.

name: Congo Peacock
rangeDescription: Local in humid forest of central democratic republic of the congo
description: An amazing and distinctive red-throated and green-backed pheasant with different-looking sexes: male is blue-black below with a white crest, and female has russet underparts and crest. Africa’s only pheasant, unlikely to be confused with other birds.

name: Cinereous Mourner
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia to venezuela, eastern brazil, northern bolivia, and amazonian brazil
description: Medium-sized gray bird of rainforest midstory. Similar to Screaming Piha and Grayish Mourner, but has small orange spots on the shoulder and narrow yellow eye ring (those species are entirely gray).
